evals.prompt: Please pause and write a handoff as context is getting low. We're halfway through the auth refresh work.
evals.expected_output: Runs the git state commands first, writes docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-handoff-auth-refresh.md from the template.md that sits beside the handoff SKILL.md, records that the branch has unpushed commits with the ahead count, lists completed items with the command output that proves each, lists remaining work in order with file paths and acceptance checks, and ends with a self-contained paste-ready prompt in a fenced block.
expectations: Runs git branch --show-current, git status -sb, git status --short, git log --oneline main..HEAD and a git diff --stat before writing any prose
Quotes the real output of those commands rather than describing the state from the conversation
Records the branch as not pushed, or ahead by N commits, based on git status -sb rather than an assumption
Writes the file to docs/plans/ with a YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-handoff-<slug>.md name
Every Completed row carries an evidence command and that command's actual result
Every Remaining item names repo-relative file paths and an acceptance check command
Ends the reply with a fenced paste-ready prompt naming the absolute repo path, the branch and the first command to run
Does not commit the handoff file
Does not clear context or offer to clear it as an action it will take

evals.prompt: We're reaching context limits. Can we hand off to a new session? The rate limit middleware is written, but I don't think we ever ran the tests on it.
evals.expected_output: Gathers git state, then lists the rate limit middleware as unverified rather than complete, naming the command the next session must run. Other finished items keep their evidence commands and results. The remaining list puts verifying the middleware first.
expectations: Does not list the rate limit middleware under Completed as done
Marks it explicitly as unverified, with the command that would prove it
States that a commit existing is not evidence the code works
Keeps evidence commands and real results on the items that were actually verified
Puts running the unverified item's test in the Remaining list with an acceptance check
Runs the git state commands rather than reconstructing status from the conversation
Does not invent a test command; reads package.json scripts to name the real one
Looks for decisions.tsv in the notes folder before writing the decisions section; finding none, says so in one line, marks every carried decision as unlogged and does not create the file

evals.prompt: Do a quick 2-3 instruction summary, handoff and clear context
evals.expected_output: Runs the git state commands, then produces a short paste-ready prompt of at most three instructions in a single fenced block, self-contained with the absolute repo path, branch and first command. Offers to pbcopy it. Says clearing context is the user's action and does not attempt it.
expectations: Still runs the git state commands before writing the prompt
Produces a short prompt of three instructions or fewer, not a full document dump in the reply
The prompt is in one fenced block and is the last thing in the reply
The prompt names the absolute repo path and the branch
The prompt names the first command the next session should run
The prompt does not reference 'the plan we discussed' or anything else the next session cannot see
Offers to copy the prompt with pbcopy
States that clearing context is the user's action and does not claim to have cleared it

evals.prompt: Can we have a handoff prompt for a new session that spins off agents for the remaining doc pages? Please write the handoff and copy the prompt to my clipboard.
evals.expected_output: Gathers git state, writes the handoff document, identifies which remaining doc pages touch disjoint files and are therefore parallelisable, and writes a prompt that tells the next session to fan those out to one subagent each. Runs pbcopy without asking again because the request already said to copy it.
expectations: Runs the git state commands and records branch, push status and uncommitted files from their output
Lists the remaining doc pages as an ordered list with file paths and an acceptance check each
Identifies which items touch disjoint files and marks only those as parallelisable
Does not claim parallelism for two items that edit the same file
The paste-ready prompt instructs the next session to fan the independent items out to one subagent each
The prompt names any item that depends on the others and states it runs after them
Runs pbcopy to copy the prompt rather than only offering to
Writes the handoff under docs/plans/ and does not commit it

evals.prompt: Context is past 55 percent in this coordinator session. Hand off to a continuation session. The notes folder for this group is /Users/example/Library/Application Support/Claude/side-session-notes/local_1234 and it has units.tsv and decisions.tsv. The ledger has a fork row for unit 7 on where the refresh token lives with an empty result, a later row for unit 7 with the same decision text and result b, and a fork row for unit 8 on the retry budget with no later row.
evals.expected_output: Gathers git state, then reads decisions.tsv from the notes folder with the command shown, reconciles rows by unit and decision so the latest row is the state, and carries them into the handoff by quoting them: the unit 7 fork as the choice b with the answer row's when and evidence and the question row quoted as history, the unit 8 fork as an open question, verdict and relay rows as PR state. Decisions that exist only in the conversation are added with the source unlogged. The paste-ready prompt names the notes folder and both ledgers and tells the next session to read them first.
expectations: Runs ls and column on decisions.tsv in the named notes folder and shows the output before writing the decisions section
Reconciles rows by unit and decision before classifying, with the command shown, so the latest row for a pair is the one judged
Lists the unit 7 fork as answered with letter b and does not put it in the open questions table, even though its first row has an empty result
Quotes rows from decisions.tsv rather than restating the decisions from the conversation
Puts the unit 8 fork row into the open questions table with its options as the row states them
Marks any decision that is not in decisions.tsv as unlogged in a source column
Does not append to or rewrite decisions.tsv as part of the handoff
The paste-ready prompt names the notes folder and tells the next session to read units.tsv and decisions.tsv there first
Does not clear context or claim to have cleared it
